Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran are the openers for Afghanistan. Kasun Rajitha to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

The visitors did bowl well but failed to get wickets at regular intervals and it hit them hard. Mohammad Nabi was the pick of the bowlers for them. Azmatullah Omarzai was a bit expensive for his likes. Nonetheless, they have an excellent batting lineup which got them over the line in the first game. Can they do it again? Or will the hosts level the series? Let's find out together. Chase coming up shortly...

So, Sri Lanka ends up with 323 runs on the board. a perfect cameo from the skipper Dasun Shanaka and the star bowler Wanindu Hasaranga helps the team to post a total in excess of 300. Sri Lanka will be happy with their efforts as they brought up their A game. They started off well but lost Pathum Nissanka in the 16th over. Dimuth Karunaratne soon followed after scoring a half-century. Kusal Mendis came on and ran a havoc after then who went on to score 78 runs and helped Sri Lanka reach a good total. Dhananjaya de Silva was brilliant with the bat too.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second game of the ODI series from Afghanistan tour of Sri Lanka. The hosts did not quite get the start they wanted and they will look to bounce back in this one.  Afghanistan had a clinical beginning to the series, securing an emphatic victory in the first ODI. They thoroughly outclassed the Lankans across departments and will aim at taking an unassailable 2-0 lead in the series.
...MATCH DAY...

It is now time for the 2nd ODI between Sri Lanka and Afghanistan at the Mahinda Rajapaksa International Stadium in Hambantota. It was a well contested first game between the two sides with the visitors coming out on top thanks to a brilliant knock by Ibrahim Zadran who fell agonizingly short of a brilliant ton and he was well-supported by the likes of Rahmat Shah and Hashmatullah Shahidi. Sri Lanka too had a good outing with the bat with almost all batters getting starts but neither of them apart from Charith Asalanka converted it into a big one. Afghanistan also had a good outing with the ball which helped restrict the hosts to a score of under 270 with Fazalhaq Farooqi and Fareed Ahmad picking up a couple of wickets. The hosts bowled decently but star pacer Matheesha Pathirana conceded too many runs and they lacked a world-class spinner in their ranks which they will be looking to change in the next game. The onus is now on the hosts to stage a fightback in front of a home crowd and level the series. Afghanistan will have their eyes on notching up a memorable series win and taking an unassailable 2-0 lead in the three-games series. All in all, it is set up to be a fascinating clash.
